sections.heading: Returns & Exchanges
items: Products can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
Items must be unused, unwashed, undamaged, and in their original packaging with all tags attached.
A valid order number or proof of purchase is required.

sections.heading: Non-Returnable Items
items: Products without original tags or packaging.
Earrings and certain accessories due to hygiene reasons.

sections.heading: Damaged or Wrong Products
sections.body: If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect product, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photographs of the item and packaging. We will arrange a replacement or refund after verification.

sections.heading: Refunds
items: Once the returned product is received and inspected, the refund will be processed.
Refunds will be credited to the original payment method within 7–10 business days.
Shipping charges, if any, are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.
